The Digital Professional in Organisations

This module explores how people, teams and leaders work within organisations shaped by digital technologies and digital transformation.

You will examine organisational behaviour, workplace culture, team dynamics, leadership, organisational structures, communication, change and professional practice in technology-enabled environments.

Throughout the module, you will work with real and international organisational cases, practical activities, group work and reflection to understand how organisations operate and how digital professionals can contribute effectively.
